brief.title: Make a paper bookmark
brief.narration: A paper bookmark is a simple craft project. Choose a small sheet of paper and fold it into a long rectangle. Add a pattern with a pencil or marker. Write a short message, then place the finished bookmark inside a book. Use your own words and images when creating a real video.
brief.caption: Fictional craft demonstration. Replace this example with your own content.

scenes.title: Choose your paper
scenes.body: Use a small sheet that folds easily.

scenes.title: Fold a rectangle
scenes.body: Make a long shape and press the fold flat.

scenes.title: Add a pattern
scenes.body: Draw simple lines or shapes with a pencil.

scenes.title: Keep your place
scenes.body: Write a short message and try it in a book.
